svg.title: AI AI Captain: DONE assessment in all five palettes
svg.desc: Fresh, aged and assessed completed sessions are compared across all five palettes, including dark and light high contrast. A verified visit after completion can assess the result at any age. Assessment cancels blinking, uses the darkest blue and a double check, and resets on a new turn. It remains a design requirement, not implemented visit tracking.

g.text: DONE keeps its meaning. Assessment changes attention.
All five palettes · Same session · Same scale · Assessment is required, not implemented.

g.text: A verified visit can assess a completed result immediately, at any age; there is no ten-minute prerequisite.
New work resets assessment. App/project activation alone cannot assess every session in that host.
Static design frames · No palette selection, runtime deployment or visit-detection implementation is implied.
